criteria.title: Users without can_create_encounter permission see no button in empty state
criteria.blocker: Environment configuration prevented authenticated app shell from loading. Frontend .env pointed to remote API instead of localhost:9000. Created .env.local with localhost API, but preview server port conflicts (4000→4001→4002) and openAuthedContext helper failed to complete UI login despite login page being accessible.
